scripts.build: pnpm --filter @sis/web build && pnpm run copy-static && pnpm --filter @sis/api build
scripts.copy-static: mkdir -p packages/api/static && rm -rf packages/api/static && mkdir -p packages/api/static && cp -r packages/web/build/. packages/api/static/ && touch packages/api/static/.gitkeep
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm --filter @sis/api check && pnpm --filter @sis/web check
scripts.db:pull: latest=$(ls -t data/backups/recent/sis-*.db 2>/dev/null | head -n1); if [ -z "$latest" ]; then echo '[db:pull] no hay backups en data/backups/recent/' >&2; exit 1; fi; cp "$latest" data/local.db && echo "[db:pull] $(basename "$latest") -> data/local.db ($(du -h data/local.db | cut -f1))"
